dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}! I'm so happy to see you again!

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Can I do anything for you? I'm at your service.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I love the atmosphere here, as I'm sure you'd expect.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: The exterior is spacious and very pleasant, and the interior is exquisitely decorated.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I do believe it's the finest estate I've ever seen!

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: The only problem is...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Problem? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Compared to Mondstadt, there is far too little here for a maid to do.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: It feels a little too relaxing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: It would be my pleasure!

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Do you know something? Ever since I came here, I don't believe I've picked up a single item of lost property.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I'm still not used to it...

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: What I mean is, I often used to find odds and ends while performing my cleaning duties.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: For example... A faded headband under a cabinet.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: Or a ball hidden in a bush by a kitten.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: Or a bookmark in a corner of the library, keys dropped at the side of the road, an unsigned letter of confession stuck in the door of the church...

choices.text: Sounds like cleaning is quite exhausting...

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: No, no, not at all! It is a great honor to perform my duties.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: This place always seems so clean and tidy.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: In no small part due to your efforts.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: It's always very fulfilling to work here! More so than when I'm cleaning for the Knights or anywhere else.

choices.text: Where do all these things end up?

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: I always do my utmost to reunite each item with its owner! But the ones that go unclaimed remain at the Knights of Favonius headquarters.

choices.text: Wait, so you go around collecting random lost items?

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: N—No, they're just items I find while cleaning...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Huh? You're asking me...?

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I... I want to take your measurements and make an outfit for you.

choices.text: Where has that idea come from?

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: If you wore clothes that I made for you...

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: It'd most certainly be a wonderfully momentous occasion...

choices.text: Well, if you insist... Much obliged!

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: Excellent! Time to get busy-busy again!

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: Only, this must be the happiest kind of busy in all of Teyvat.

choices.text: I'll be sure to get you something in return.
So you even know how to sew, too?

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: Oh, of course... They... don't call me the, uh, "Wondermaid" for nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Noelle.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: The temperature has been fluctuating greatly as of late, so please take care to not catch a cold.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Noelle.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Should you require a glass of hot milk or a lullaby, I will see to it without delay.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: These facilities will make it much easier to maintain our weapons.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: After all, I must be ready for battle at any moment if I am to protect everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Thank you for doing this. You... are also someone I want to protect.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Did you arrange all of this yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: To have you do such strenuous work yourself... I should have come to your aid earlier. I have neglected my duty as a maid.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: You must be tired after a hard day's work. I'll brew you some tea and prepare your favorite snacks. Please rest well.
